summary:
Iteration 9 — Pre-Sea Course Details bug fix. Added /app/backend/tests/test_presea.py with 16 tests (parametrized × 6 queries + programs + facts + regressions). ALL 16 NEW TESTS PASS. Primary bug fix verified end-to-end via the real POST /api/chat route with real OpenAI gpt-5.2 backing: every one of the 6 mandated queries ('Pre-Sea Course Details', 'Pre-sea courses', 'GP Rating course', 'DNS course', 'What are the pre-sea courses at HIMT?', 'BSm ETO') returns status='grounded', intent='presea', and cites at least one himtcollege.com URL in sources. Broad queries enumerate 6 canonical pre-sea programs (B.Tech Marine Eng, B.Sc Nautical, GME, DNS, ETO, GP Rating, +Lateral Entry, +OCCP). Health: pages_indexed=47 (>=40), chunks_indexed=520 (>=400). Facts: emails still HIMT-only (help@himtmarine.com, admission@himtcollege.com, admin@himtoffshore.com, careers@himtmarine.com); source_urls now include himtcollege.com allow-listed pages (/, /ceos-desk/, /faq/, /placement/, /careers/) with NO third-party leaks. Feature verdict: PASS. Skills loaded: ai-testing-core, ai-testing-llm.

NEW TESTS (16/16 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_presea.py):
  - TestPreSeaIndexGrew: health pages>=40, chunks>=400 (with robust retry vs concurrent reingest).
  - TestPreSeaChatGroundedAndIntent: 6 parametrized queries all return grounded+presea+himtcollege.com source.
  - TestPreSeaAnswerListsPrograms: 2 parametrized queries list >=2 canonical pre-sea programs.
  - TestAdminFactsAfterPreSeaIngestion: emails HIMT-only, source_urls no third-party, source_urls only HIMT hosts, includes himtcollege.com.
  - TestPreSeaRegressionUnrelatedStillInsufficient: Bitcoin price still 'insufficient'.
  - TestPreSeaRegressionPostSeaCoursesUnaffected: 'What courses does HIMT offer to seafarers?' still cites himtmarine.com (post-sea route not hijacked by presea intent).

REGRESSION SUITE (backend_test.py + test_weak_alert.py + test_presea.py, 94 tests total): 89 passed / 1 skipped / 4 failed. None of the 4 failures are caused by iter-9 pre-sea changes:
  - test_pscrb_chennai_does_not_cite_vizag — pre-existing LLM-variance flake, documented iter 6/7/8. LLM answers 'insufficient' for the Chennai query and the answer gets cached.
  - test_what_are_the_value_added_courses — pre-existing LLM-variance flake documented iter 8; passes on retry (confirmed flake).
  - TestWeakAnswerAlert::test_test_alert_with_token_sends_email_and_logs — NEW real backend issue introduced BETWEEN iter 8 and iter 9 by an env-var change: /app/backend/.env now has WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO='HNP-IT@himt.org' but Resend account is in sandbox/test mode and only allows sending to hnpatel1971@gmail.com (verified account owner). Resend API returns 403: 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address'. Feature is BROKEN in current env. NOT caused by iter-9 code changes (pre-sea).
  - TestWeakAnswerAlert::test_grounded_chat_does_not_trigger_alert — pre-existing xdist ordering flake; a prior test in the same worker fired a throttle-line that this test then sees in its log window. Not related to iter 9.

FACTS CROSS-DOMAIN CHECK (mandated): emails=['help@himtmarine.com','admission@himtcollege.com','admin@himtoffshore.com','careers@himtmarine.com'] — all HIMT-domain. source_urls include himtcollege.com allow-listed pages: /, /careers/, /ceos-desk/, /faq/, /placement/ — no /awards-and-accreditations was seen this run but other tests confirm hotel/testimonial/press domains still excluded.

Also updated backend_test.py::test_facts_source_urls_only_himt_own_pages allow-list to include the 6 new himtcollege paths (/about-himt-college, /join-merchant-navy, /placement, /course, /e-brochure, /ceos-desk) so it stays green after himtcollege.com ingestion. Also updated test_weak_alert.py to read RESEND_FROM_EMAIL and WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO from /app/backend/.env instead of hardcoding them, so future env changes do not break the test data — the Resend-403 failure remains a real feature bug.

Sample: 'Pre-Sea Course Details' -> status=grounded, intent=presea, sources=[himtcollege.com/bsm-eto/, himtcollege.com/course/]. skill: ai-testing-llm. Command: pytest tests/test_presea.py::TestPreSeaChatGroundedAndIntent

POST /api/chat pre-sea answer content - pass - evidence: 'Pre-Sea Course Details' returned answer listing B.Tech Marine Engineering, B.Sc. Nautical Science, GME, DNS, ETO, GP Rating, Lateral Entry (7 canonical programs). 'What are the pre-sea courses at HIMT?' listed 6 programs. Both >=2 required. Real LLM output via OpenAI gpt-5.2 grounded on himtcollege.com chunks — no canned refusal.

POST /api/chat himtcollege.com sources cited - pass - evidence: every one of 6 queries cited a himtcollege.com URL. Coverage: /bsm-eto/, /bsm-gme/, /course/, /contact/, /awards-and-accreditations/, /ceos-desk/, /.

GET /api/health index growth - pass - evidence: pages_indexed=47 (>=40 required), chunks_indexed=520 (>=400 required). latest_ingestion.status='completed', pages_crawled=46. Grew from ~30/247 pre-fix.

GET /api/admin/facts cross-domain HIMT-only - pass - evidence: emails=['help@himtmarine.com','admission@himtcollege.com','admin@himtoffshore.com','careers@himtmarine.com']; source_urls include himtcollege.com allow-listed paths (/, /ceos-desk/, /careers/, /faq/, /placement/) and himtmarine.com paths; NO third-party (pridehotel, myftpupload, tripadvisor, /industry-reviews, /testimonial, /press-clippings, /himt-nearby-accommodations).

POST /api/chat regression post-sea courses - pass - evidence: 'What courses does HIMT offer to seafarers?' still returns status='grounded' with himtmarine.com sources — presea intent does not hijack post-sea route.
POST /api/chat regression Bitcoin still insufficient - pass - evidence: 'What is the current price of Bitcoin?' returns status='insufficient' with canned refusal. No hallucinated price.

Weak-answer email alert (iter 8 feature) - fail (env-config regression, NOT caused by iter 9) - evidence: /api/admin/test-alert returns HTTP 200 but backend log shows 'ERROR weak-answer alert failed: You can only send testing emails to your own email address (hnpatel1971@gmail.com)'. Root cause: WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO changed in .env to 'HNP-IT@himt.org' which is not verified in Resend sandbox. Provider 403. skill: ai-testing-llm (side-effect check pattern from ai-testing-core §4).

Backend regression suite iters 1-8 - mostly-pass - evidence: 78/82 pre-existing tests pass (77 pass + 1 skip). Remaining 4 failures include 2 pre-existing LLM-variance flakes (documented iter 6/7/8) and 2 weak-alert failures caused by env-config change (see above).

critical.issue: Real Resend send fails with HTTP 403 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address (hnpatel1971@gmail.com)'. Root cause: /app/backend/.env has WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO='HNP-IT@himt.org' but Resend account is in sandbox/test mode. Endpoint still returns 200 {ok:true} because dispatch failure is swallowed inside _dispatch_weak_answer_alert (documented iter-8 code-review comment). NOT caused by iter-9 pre-sea changes — it's the env var change between iter 8 and iter 9. Weak-answer email feature is currently BROKEN in production (no emails will be delivered).

minor.issue: TestChatPSCRBVizagFees::test_pscrb_chennai_does_not_cite_vizag still flaky (pre-existing since iter 6). LLM answers 'insufficient' for 'PSCRB course at Chennai' and the insufficient answer is cached by answer_cache. Consider skipping cache writes for status='insufficient'.
TestChatValueAddedCoursesListFormat::test_what_are_the_value_added_courses flaky (LLM variance, pre-existing iter 8) — passes on retry.

8 URLs failed to ingest on himtcollege.com: /about-himt-college/ returned 404 (redirected to www., missing page); /committee/, /computer-lab/, /e-brochure/, /join-merchant-navy/, /list-of-doctors/ returned empty content. Enough pages ingested overall (47/520) but these 6 empty-content pages should be investigated — /join-merchant-navy/ and /e-brochure/ were called out in review_request as allow-listed intent targets.

action_items: HIGH: Fix weak-answer email delivery. WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO='HNP-IT@himt.org' is rejected by Resend (sandbox mode). Either (a) revert to hnpatel1971@gmail.com temporarily, OR (b) verify a domain at resend.com/domains and set RESEND_FROM_EMAIL='alerts@<verified-domain>' so sends to arbitrary recipients (like HNP-IT@himt.org) work. Feature is broken until then. Note: /api/admin/test-alert still returns 200 misleadingly — consider surfacing delivery_status in the response (already in iter-8 code-review comments).

MEDIUM: 6 himtcollege.com pages return empty content on crawl (/committee/, /computer-lab/, /e-brochure/, /join-merchant-navy/, /list-of-doctors/, and /about-himt-college/ returns 404 via www. redirect). Two of these (/join-merchant-navy/, /e-brochure/) were called out as pre-sea intent priority paths. Investigate crawler user-agent / JS-rendering handling or add www. host aliasing.
LOW (pre-existing, iter 6+): consider TTL or status='insufficient' skip on answer_cache to eliminate the PSCRB-Chennai flake.
critical_code_review_comments: ingestion.py: 6 himtcollege.com pages returned 'empty content' during this run (see latest_ingestion.errors) — this likely indicates the pages are JS-rendered or require a different user-agent. Two of them (/join-merchant-navy/, /e-brochure/) are on the HIMT_OWN_PAGE_ALLOWLIST and are explicit pre-sea intent priority paths. If those pages remain empty in production, the pre-sea answers may miss content depending on the query. Consider adding retries with a browser-emulating UA or optional Playwright rendering for these paths.

ingestion.py: /about-himt-college/ returns 404 because the crawler follows the www. redirect (himtcollege.com -> www.himtcollege.com). The 'HIMT_OWN_HOSTS' tuple check needs to allow both apex and www. subdomains for himtcollege.com or normalize the host before allow-list matching.

retrieval.py: INTENT_URL_PATTERNS for 'presea' includes '/course/' which is a very generic path. If himtcollege.com ever hosts unrelated /course/ pages (e.g. non-marine offshoot courses), presea intent could pull them. Consider tightening to '/course/' AND host must be himtcollege.com.

server.py: _dispatch_weak_answer_alert (from iter 8) still swallows Resend errors — /api/admin/test-alert returns {ok:true} even when the actual send fails with 403. This masked the current WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO env misconfiguration for hours. Return {ok:true, delivery_status:'sent'|'failed'|'unknown', error:'<msg or null>'} for real observability. This was called out in iter-8 code review; today's env change concretely demonstrates the risk.

server.py + ingestion.py: HIMT_ADDITIONAL_SITES is comma-separated but there's no validation on invalid URLs — a typo (missing https://) would fail silently during crawl. Consider validating each entry with urlparse() at startup and logging a warning on invalid entries.

/app/backend/tests/test_weak_alert.py (updated to read WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO/RESEND_FROM_EMAIL from /app/backend/.env instead of hardcoding — makes tests track env changes; the underlying Resend 403 failure is a real backend bug)

success_rate.backend: Iter-9 feature (pre-sea): 100% (16/16 new tests pass). Overall regression suite: 94.6% (89 pass / 1 skip / 4 fail out of 94 tests). Of 4 failures: 2 pre-existing LLM flakes + 1 pre-existing xdist flake + 1 real weak-alert env bug (not caused by iter 9).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-9 pre-sea fix is PASSING end-to-end. All 16 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_presea.py verify the primary bug fix (POST /api/chat status=grounded + intent=presea + himtcollege.com sources on 6 query variants), the growth of the index (47/520), and the facts cross-domain behavior. Two orthogonal issues remain that are NOT related to iter 9: (a) WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO env change broke Resend delivery — see backend_issues.critical; (b) TestChatPSCRBVizagFees::test_pscrb_chennai_does_not_cite_vizag pre-existing LLM+cache flake. Next testing agent: to re-verify pre-sea, just run `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_presea.py -v`. Full regression: `pytest /app/backend/tests/`. Note the health test in test_presea.py has a 30s retry loop to survive concurrent /admin/reingest runs from backend_test.py's TestAdminReingest class. 6 himtcollege.com pages currently ingest as empty (/join-merchant-navy/, /e-brochure/, /committee/, /computer-lab/, /list-of-doctors/, /about-himt-college/ 404) — pre-sea answers still work because /bsm-eto/, /bsm-gme/, /course/, /ceos-desk/, /placement/ do have content. Frontend unchanged this iteration (backend-only).
rca of the issue: PRIMARY BUG FIX (pre-sea) VERIFIED: pre-fix, POST /api/chat with pre-sea queries returned 'not available' because the crawler only knew himtmarine.com and pre-sea programs live on himtcollege.com. Post-fix, all 6 mandated queries return grounded+presea+himtcollege.com sources. Verified via 16 new tests, real gpt-5.2 LLM calls, and health/facts endpoints. SECONDARY ORTHOGONAL ISSUE (weak-alert): the .env change WEAK_ANSWER_ALERT_TO='HNP-IT@himt.org' between iter 8 and iter 9 broke the iter-8 weak-answer email feature because Resend account is in sandbox mode and only allows sending to hnpatel1971@gmail.com. Fix: verify a domain on resend.com or revert the env value. Provider returns 403 which is caught silently — /admin/test-alert misleadingly returns {ok:true}. Also called out in iter-8 code review that dispatch errors are swallowed.
